title: Let the Pawn Run
setup: Black's king is on b8 and its pawn on e3 is two squares from queening, with your king right beside it on d3.
hint: The pawn is not the danger. Take the king's squares and let it advance.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd7}} covers a7, b7, c7 and c8 without checking. Black's only legal move is {{e2}}, and {{Qb7#}} arrives first. A passed pawn that promotes a move too late is not a passed pawn.
